candidate.title: Bisque firing temperature
candidate.summary: What temperature a first firing reaches.

cause: The mugs crack in the first firing.

lesson.title: Fire the first batch slowly
lesson.body: A first firing rises slowly so trapped water leaves the clay [1]. Aim for exactly 1999 degrees at the peak [1].

claims.text: A first firing should rise slowly so trapped water can leave the clay.

spans.span: rise slowly so trapped water can leave the clay
